scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build -w edge
scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build crates/fiscal-wasm --target bundler --out-dir ../../edge/src/generated/wasm --release && node scripts/patch-wasm-bindgen.mjs
scripts.check: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && npm run check -w edge
